authority_policy: Official Korean government/NIER sources define legal/publication status. IEPS CERT_TYP=6&tab=seven is the primary document-discovery feed. Bibliographic or official publication evidence can establish that a newer revision exists, but a superseded edition is never silently substituted when the newer official download locator is not yet byte-verified.
matching_policy: Company/site matching uses only preferred=true family revisions. Industry, process and common-facility references can coexist for one site. Candidate mapping is reference applicability only and never proof of company BAT adoption.
